brief:
A modeling reference sheet (turnaround) for ONE low-poly 3D game asset: a chunky bronze temple bell that hangs in a mountain shrine.

Canvas and layout, keep exactly:
- 1536 x 1024 landscape image, a 2 x 2 grid of four equal panels.
- Top-left panel: FRONT view. Top-right: RIGHT side view. Bottom-left: BACK view. Bottom-right: TOP view (looking straight down).
- Orthographic cameras (no perspective), the same scale in every panel, the object centred in each panel and standing on the same invisible ground line in the three side views (the bell's lip rests on it).
- Every view sits whole inside its panel with a clear margin of background all round (at least a tenth of the panel): nothing touches or crosses a panel edge.
- Each side view is exactly frontal to its side: no other face of the object shows in it, the lip is a straight horizontal line (no ellipse of the opening visible).
- The four panels show the SAME object, only turned: FRONT: the round strike boss faces the camera and the hanging loop on top is seen as a full ring (an O). RIGHT: the camera has walked round to the side that was on the RIGHT of the image in the front view; the loop is seen edge-on as a thick upright bar, and the two strike bosses stick out a little at the left and right edges of the body. BACK: like the front (the second boss faces the camera, the loop a full ring). TOP: seen from straight above: a circle (the dome) with the loop as a thick bar running left to right across its centre, the two bosses peeking out at the top and bottom edges of the circle. Each detail appears only in the views from which it is really visible.
- One flat, uniform, mid grey background (#9a9a9a) everywhere: no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no frame lines, no text, no labels.

The object (identical in all four views), 1.25 m wide at the lip, 1.9 m tall including the loop:
- Body: an eight-sided (octagonal) bell, a slightly tapering prism 1.1 m wide at the top shoulder and 1.25 m at the lip, 1.35 m tall, with a short outward flare at the lip.
- Dome: a low faceted dome cap 0.25 m tall on top of the body.
- Two raised bands wrapped round the body: one 0.12 m tall a quarter of the way down from the shoulder, one 0.12 m tall just above the lip.
- Strike bosses: a thick round disc 0.36 m wide and 0.08 m proud on the FRONT and on the BACK, centred a third of the way up from the lip.
- Hanging loop: a thick chunky ring 0.5 m across, tube 0.13 m thick, standing upright on top of the dome, in the same plane as the front view (we see it as an O from the front and back).

Style, keep exactly:
- A clean low-poly 3D model render: faceted, flat-shaded faces, hard straight edges, big readable chunky shapes, about 300 triangles worth of detail. No smooth organic surfaces, no engraving, no text, no tiny details, no texture noise, no grain.
- Flat colour areas only, ONLY these colours (an 8-colour palette, Citrink): bell body bright yellow #fcf660 (lit faces) and #b2d942 (shaded faces); bands, strike bosses and the loop teal #166e7a.
- Soft, even light from the upper left, so each face reads as one flat tone; no specular highlights, no ambient occlusion blur.
